title: gate add classes a gate as secrets when its text says output tokens
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons does not class a gate as secrets because its question or options say tokens in the sense of a model's token counts (output tokens, token counts); a credential-sense token (bearer token, access token, API token, PAT) still classes it secrets

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_authority as a; c=a.class_reasons({}, {"id":"g1","question":"Which count is the output tokens?","options":["the main loop","the whole run"]})[0]; assert c!="secrets", c
